blogs.title: Breaking the GPU Barrier: How QLoRA Makes Massive LLMs Accessible to Everyone
blogs.description: A high-level look at how QLoRA democratizes AI by reducing the memory requirements for finetuning a 65B parameter model from over 780GB to under 48GB. This post explains why this is a game-changer for independent researchers and hobbyists who only have access to a single GPU.

blogs.title: Under the Hood of QLoRA: NF4, Double Quantization, and the Magic of 4-Bit Training
blogs.description: A technical but accessible deep dive into the three core innovations that make QLoRA possible: 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4), Double Quantization, and Paged Optimizers. This post explains how these techniques shrink model size without sacrificing the intelligence or performance of the LLM.

blogs.title: Meet Guanaco: The Open-Source Challenger Rivaling ChatGPT
blogs.description: An exploration of the Guanaco model family. This post discusses the impressive results of the paper, where a 4-bit quantized model reached 99.3% of ChatGPT's performance on the Vicuna benchmark, proving that you don't need massive compute clusters to build a world-class chatbot.

blogs.title: Quality Over Quantity: What QLoRA Teaches Us About Training Better AI
blogs.description: Focusing on the research paper's analysis of instruction datasets, this post explains the surprising finding that small, high-quality datasets can outperform massive ones. It explores the 'orthogonality' of benchmarks and why the right data matters more than the amount of data.
